title: Lipid extractions from labyrinthulomycetes
author: Laura Halligan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qbddsi6

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Add 2.0 ml of cells to a pre‑weighed 2.0 ml microcentrifuge tube, spin down to form a pellet, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Weigh cell pellet
steps.instruction: Weigh the 2.0 ml microcentrifuge tube containing the fresh cell pellet and record the weight (difference from the empty tube gives cell mass).

steps.title: Add initial Folch solvent
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 ml Folch solvent (2 : 1 chloroform / methanol) to the pellet in the 2.0 ml tube.

steps.title: Homogenize pellet
steps.instruction: Manually homogenize the pellet with a Fisher Scientific pestle (catalog no. 12‑141‑363).

steps.title: Add remaining Folch solvent
steps.instruction: Add an additional 0.5 ml Folch solvent (total Folch volume = 1.5 ml).

steps.title: Spin pellet
steps.instruction: Spin the 2.0 ml tube at 13.2 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a 15 ml polypropylene centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add Folch to supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 4.5 ml Folch solvent to the supernatant in the 15 ml tube.

steps.title: Add NaCl and mix
steps.instruction: Add 1.2 ml 0.9 % NaCl to the mixture, then shake the Folch‑NaCl mixture before centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 15 ml tube at 6,000 g for 6 minutes.

steps.title: Collect chloroform phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the bottom chloroform phase to a labeled 15 ml centrifuge tube ('A' for the first extraction or 'B' for the second), avoiding debris and the aqueous top phase.

steps.title: Prepare labeled tubes
steps.instruction: Weigh an empty 2.0 ml polypropylene microcentrifuge tube and record its weight. Label two 15 ml polypropylene centrifuge tubes 'A' and 'B' (first extraction = A, second extraction = B) and have two additional 15 ml tubes ready for steps 8–11.

steps.title: Second extraction on remaining pellet
steps.instruction: Using the remaining cell pellet in the original 2.0 ml tube, repeat steps 3–11 (add Folch, homogenize, add Folch, spin, transfer supernatant, add Folch, add NaCl, centrifuge, collect bottom phase) and label the collected phase as 'B'.

steps.title: Dry chloroform phases
steps.instruction: Place the labeled 15 ml tubes containing the chloroform phases under a filtered air stream and allow them to dry until mostly dry.

steps.title: Label and weigh aluminum dishes
steps.instruction: Label two 0.35 ml aluminum micro‑weighing dishes (VWR catalog no. 12577‑062) as 'A' and 'B', let the ink dry, then weigh each dish on a milligram balance and record the weights.

steps.title: Transfer extracts to dishes
steps.instruction: When the extracts in the 15 ml tubes are mostly dry, transfer them to 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tubes; once those are mostly dry, transfer to the 0.35 ml aluminum dishes. Rinse the 1.5 ml tubes with 300 µl Folch solvent to redissolve the lipids, then perform one or two additional rinses with ~100 µl Folch solvent, ensuring all lipid material is transferred and the tubes are clean. Allow the Folch solvent in the dishes to evaporate between washes if needed.

steps.title: Dry dishes to constant weight
steps.instruction: Leave the aluminum dishes with the lipid extracts under a filtered air stream (typically ~2 days) until the extracts are fully dry.

steps.title: Weigh dried lipids
steps.instruction: Weigh the dried lipid extracts in the aluminum dishes using a milligram balance and record the final masses.
